Claire (Design): quick pass on contrast + tooltip reading order — noticed a couple of low-contrast tooltips and a confusing focus jump after the model switcher modal closes. Can we triage?
Alex (DevEx): I saw that in staging too. Tooltip bg is #F3F4F6 with text #6B7280 — that's ~3.2:1, needs 4.5:1 for body text. Suggest darker text or darker bg.
Nate (Eng): For the modal close focus issue, after close focus lands on body instead of the model button. We should restore focus to the triggering button with elem.focus() and tabindex=-1 fallback.
Maria (PM): Agree. Also toast SR announce is missing sometimes — screen reader doesn't pick up the success message when it's triggered by the background job.
Jo (A11y): For toasts use role="status" + aria-live="polite" and aria-atomic="true". Don’t move keyboard focus to toasts unless it’s a blocking error.
Alex (DevEx): Quick CSS suggestion for focus ring we could standardize across the console:
```:focus { outline: 3px solid #005F73; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px; }
```
Alex (DevEx): Also small copy tweak for the model switcher tooltip: change "Switch model" -> "Choose model (press Enter to select)" — clearer for keyboard users.
Claire (Design): Good. Can we decide whether tooltips use AA or AAA? For short helper text we should aim for AA (4.5:1). Reserve AAA for large/display text.
Nate (Eng): Another keyboard nit: in compact table mode the filter chips are being skipped when tabbing — looks like tabindex is being set to -1 on chips when row density=compact. That's accidental.
Jo (A11y): Also audit aria-labels on the table sort buttons — screen reader announced "button" with no context in VoiceOver. Should be "Sort by requests, ascending" etc.
a11y-bot: Automated scan results for thread 2468101357 — tooltip-1: FAIL (contrast 3.2:1), toast-announce: WARN (aria-live missing), modal-focus: WARN (no return focus), table-chips: WARN (tabindex -1 in compact). See attached report: /reports/2468101357 (internal).
Maria (PM): Thanks. Priority: tooltip contrast + modal focus return for the next patch. Can we ship tooltip fix in next patch release? :thumbsup:
Alex (DevEx): I'll open a PR with color tweaks and a small visuals test page. Will include before/after screenshots and a contrast checker snapshot. Added :eyes: reaction.
Jo (A11y): I'll add keyboard/unit tests for chips tab order and a screen reader smoke test for toast announces.
Nate (Eng): I'll implement focus restore on modal close (store lastActiveElem, focus it on close, fallback to trigger button).
Claire (Design): Thanks all — I'll consolidate these into the accessibility doc and add the copy change. Draft link: https://redwood.in/design/contrast-guidelines. Assigning owners in the doc now.
Maria (PM): I'll track in the patch milestone and mark QA steps (contrast check, keyboard pass, SR smoke).
Claire (Design): Closing loop — leave any follow-ups here.
